name: skafld-vc-connectors
description: Optional connectors for SkaFld VC: paid company data (Crunchbase, PitchBook, CB Insights, Tracxn, Coresignal), more CRMs and note-takers, data rooms, portfolio and finance metrics (AngelList, Stripe, ChartMogul, Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Mercury, Brex, Ramp), public comparables (S&P Global, Morningstar, Daloopa, Alpha Vantage, FMP) and contracts (PandaDoc, Ironclad). Each signs in with your own account; install only if you use these tools.
